result.summary: Overall the food delivery home screen looks well-structured. Minor polish issues only: inconsistent badge/pill styling and a search field placeholder that could contrast better.

issues.description: The '15–25 min' badge on the Green Bowl Poké card sits partially outside/overhanging the left edge of the card, unlike other cards where badges are fully inside the image area.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent corner radii for overlay badges and pills for visual coherence.

issues.description: Search input placeholder text is very light gray on a light gray background, reducing readability of the hint text.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text color to meet WCAG contrast recommendations while keeping the hint discoverable.
